observations.behavior: Adds redirect-following and port/host matching to sitemap discovery; also adds a refresh-cap and several unit tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the content-autopilot discovery to follow HTTP redirects while remaining within the same origin, and to preserve port and host identity when matching URLs against an origin. This could prevent missing pages behind redirects and could keep discovered URLs consistent with the configured origin. The refresh-cap could prevent unbounded API or database reads.

observations.behavior: Replaces string-based XML tag parsing with a helper and passes origin parameters to the site-matching helper.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the sitemap parser more robust and portable, and enables the site-matching helper to use the origin's scheme, host and port rather than reconstructing them. This could reduce false positives and support non-standard ports or schemes.

observations.behavior: Adds a refresh-cap and exports the constant, and uses it to limit the number of opportunities returned.
observations.posthog_connection: Could prevent unbounded database reads and keep the refresh response bounded, which could help stability and response time. The constant is exported and used, but its value is not shown in this chunk.
